thread:
alyssa: Heads-up — I'm drafting a 'runtime metrics bundle' to hand to PMs for the next dashboard sprint. Need concrete runtime/infra inputs: routing_policy label (e.g. cost vs latency), pool_tier, token_charged, prefix_cache_hit_rate, request_latency_p95, instance_health. Who owns producing these as stable Grafana/readonly Prometheus series? :eyes:

sam: @alyssa we own the runtime labels but not sure about 'token_charged' attribution. billing team? Also need to think about customer-facing names vs internal names.

jia: For token attribution we can export an aggregated 'tokens_billed_per_org' metric from the RPC layer. Raw per-instance counters shouldn't be exposed. Can add labels: model, route_id, policy.

maria: +1 to aggregated only for external. Also we must strip hostname/instance_id and IPs before a dashboard is shareable outside infra.

kevin: UX question: do we want a 'Share external' toggle at dashboard level or at folder level? Folder-level can make corporate templates easier.

ops-bot: Deploy completed: metric-exporter v3.2 tagged. sources: runtime, routing. (<https://ci.internal/repo/metrics-exporter/3.2|ci link>)

alyssa: Proposal for RBAC policy snippet for share perms (internal product/admin vs external):
```
{
  "principal": "team:product",
  "actions": ["view", "share:external"],
  "resources": ["dashboard:runtime-exposed"]
}
```
This is a starting point; need legal review for external share audit trail.

sam: From telemetry side we'll add a read-only 'dashboard_view' label so we can track who viewed shared dashboards. Example query to get view counts:
```
SELECT viewer_team, dashboard_id, count(*) as views
FROM dashboard_access_logs
WHERE shared_external = true
  AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY viewer_team, dashboard_id;
```

jia: We also need automatic PII masking hook when a dashboard contains request metadata. Perhaps a 'sanitizer' that runs on export and replaces any identifier-looking strings with <REDACTED>.

maria: Audit retention: legal wants 1 year of share events (who, when, what dashboard snapshot). Can we store snapshots as JSON blobs and hash them for integrity checks?

kevin: For rollouts, I'd prefer canary on 'share:external' permission. Start with 5% of product org, then 50%, then all. Also product UX should warn: "This will create an externally-accessible snapshot. Audit logs will be recorded." small modal.

alyssa: Great. Actions:
- @sam hook up 'tokens_billed_per_org' export (owner: runtime)
- @jia implement sanitizer and aggregated export
- @maria design audit snapshot storage + retention plan
- @kevin wire share toggle + staged rollout plan
I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 to finalize API shapes. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
